spot.html_text: Frantz Fanon was one of the leading theorists of the struggle for decolonization. His two most influential works focused on anti-black racism and the impact of colonial violence. Black Skin, White Masks (2008 [1952]) describes racialized subjectivity and the structural conditions that sustain racial domination.
